nodes.label: vision.blocks
nodes.op_formula_derived:
norm1 = rmsnorm(x)
attn.wqkv = linear(norm1)
attn.q_flat = slice(attn.wqkv)
attn.q_split = head_split(attn.q_flat)
attn.q_rope = rope_2d(attn.q_split)
attn.k_flat = slice(attn.wqkv)
attn.k_split = head_split(attn.k_flat)
attn.k_rope = rope_2d(attn.k_split)
attn.score = attention_score(attn.q_rope, attn.k_rope)
attn.softmax = softmax(attn.score)
attn.v_flat = slice(attn.wqkv)
attn.v_split = head_split(attn.v_flat)
attn.apply = attention_apply(attn.softmax, attn.v_split)
attn.o_merge = head_merge(attn.apply)
attn.wo = linear(attn.o_merge)
attn_residual = add(x, attn.wo)
norm2 = rmsnorm(attn_residual)
mlp.w1 = linear(norm2)
mlp.gate = slice(mlp.w1)
mlp.act = silu(mlp.gate)
mlp.up = slice(mlp.w1)
mlp.gated = mul(mlp.act, mlp.up)
mlp.w2 = linear(mlp.gated)
out = add(attn_residual, mlp.w2)

slots.description: CSA2 compressed-KV store: rotate the compressor's pre-RoPE latent, keep it in this layer's compressed cache and read back the rows the attention's union joins. Publishes compress_kv.
CSA2 KV compressor, ratio > 1: gated softmax pooling of compress_ratio consecutive tokens into one pre-RoPE latent (wkv / wgate / norm, no position table).
CSA2 indexer, key-owning form: own index keys off the compressor's pre-RoPE latent, own key cache, scores and top-K. Publishes index_k and csa_topk.
CSA2 compressed-KV read: the rows an earlier kv-source layer published, under the read law the score applies. Stores nothing.
CSA2 shared compressed latent: the rows the nearest kv-source layer published, read where a Compressor would stand. No weights, no cache.
CSA2 selection, consumer form: the top-K compressed positions the nearest index source published, read as the shared list it is. No weights, no cache.
CSA2 compressed-KV read: the rows an earlier kv-source layer published, under the read law the score applies. Stores nothing.
CSA2 shared compressed latent: the rows the nearest kv-source layer published, read where a Compressor would stand. No weights, no cache.
CSA2 selection, consumer form: the top-K compressed positions the nearest index source published, read as the shared list it is. No weights, no cache.
CSA2 compressed-KV store: rotate the compressor's pre-RoPE latent, keep it in this layer's compressed cache and read back the rows the attention's union joins. Publishes compress_kv.
CSA2 KV compressor, ratio == 1: the plain projection branch (wkv + norm, no gate, no pooling) producing the pre-RoPE latent.
CSA2 indexer, key-owning + candidate-source form: as csa2_indexer plus level one of the two-level top-K (candidate blocks). Publishes index_k, candidates and csa_topk.
CSA2 compressed-KV read: the rows an earlier kv-source layer published, under the read law the score applies. Stores nothing.
CSA2 shared compressed latent: the rows the nearest kv-source layer published, read where a Compressor would stand. No weights, no cache.
CSA2 indexer, shared-keys form: re-scores the shared index keys with its own wq_b / weights_proj inside the candidate source's blocks and publishes csa_topk. No wk, no key cache.
